mission.Corp_Corp_Control2.details:
Details: Our analysts monitor messages in the SBN in order to understand who needs our services. Something interesting is happening at %STATION_NAME%.

%VICTIM_NAME% recently experienced an unpleasant incident at one of its assets. Our colleagues worked there. Apparently the client was %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It has already prepared cargo to be sent to the contractor as payment. Now %VICTIM_NAME% is trying to take revenge by destroying this cargo. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has placed a contract to protect the parcel.

You need to repel all attacks until the contractor takes the due reward.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control2.objective0: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the cargo</color> prepared for sending to the PMC. It is a mountain of boxes. You yourself have seen them many times in the cargo hold of Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Defense1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retained control of %STATION_NAME%. Direct actions proved to be a losing strategy for %VICTIM_NAME%. This means that it will now move on to murder, espionage, and sabotage. Again, this is good news and new contracts for us. In the meantime, Magnum received a cargo from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% as gratitude for the work.
mission.Corp_Corp_Defense1.briefing: It is necessary to <color=#FFFEC1>take a defensive position</color> and force the attackers to retreat. We should not expect that our opponents will be the security %VICTIM_NAME%. Such problems are solved only by <color=#FFFEC1>PMCs</color>. We shouldn't worry about any collateral damage. We have one <color=#FFFEC1>mission</color>: to ensure that %STATION_NAME% remains the property of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% when the dust settles and the smoke clears.
mission.Corp_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is actively increasing its influence in the Solar System. It uses the chaos of the new redistribution of property for sabotage, murder, espionage against competitors, the Unchained Belt and the Civil Resistance. %STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called "direct actions" on its part. Yes, we are talking about a takeover.

The current owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, is already sending out protests through official channels. And contracts to ensure the safety of the station are unofficial. Let's work!

Simple task: we land and destroy all the attackers until they stop trying to take the object by storm. Let's hold the station, and gratitude to %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be very significant.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination1.after: Market balance has been restored. Now everyone is on an equal footing again. This is why we love <color=#FFFEC1>egalitarian capitalism</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a valuable package so that we could conduct field tests. There are some of its new products. The cargo is already on board of Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination1.briefing: The target's signature is visible on the sensors. It won't be difficult to identify them - look for <color=#FFFEC1>white robe</color> and a smart face. This breed of people clings to traditions so much that they don’t even need an ancap - they would be happy even with a caste system. We will land the shuttle at a location in %STATION_NAME% where the defense systems allow it. Move from level to level until you reach the target. Resistance is expected: local <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service or PMC</color> are already occupying combat posts. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, it is not prohibited by the contract.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the scientist of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Fair competition is the key to rapid progress in science. How is this described in <color=#FFFEC1>NCE</color>? Lagging behind competitors will inevitably force the entrepreneur to multiply its efforts in order to maintain its position in the Market. So let's multiply. From the analysis of the SBN traffic, it became clear that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is interested in the <color=#FFFEC1>scientist</color>, currently working at %STATION_NAME%. Not in the scientist itself, but in obstructing their work. Apparently, %VICTIM_NAME% is planning some kind of breakthrough. If it happens, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will lose its position in the market. We are expected to act cleanly and quickly: boarding, search, <color=#FFFEC1>elimination of target</color>, then evacuation.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination1.objective: New day, new routine job. Your target: <color=#FFFEC1>scientist</color>, probably working on something extremely useful for all humanity.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination2.after: In a couple of days we expect an announcement on the sale of %STATION_NAME% on the System Exchange. The job is done, all that remains is to try out the contents of the package that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% gave us as a reward. It's already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination2.briefing: We were given the target's personal signature. Good news: they are located at %STATION_NAME%. The shuttle will land wherever it can, and then your work will begin. Moderate resistance is expected from the Security Service of %VICTIM_NAME% or the PMCs working for it. <color=#FFFEC1>Eliminate the target and return</color>. Try not to get too distracted exploring %STATION_NAME%, it's not our priority.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate a high-ranking manager of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination2.details:
Details: Fair competition is what made anarcho-capitalism the fairest system humanity has ever known. In the SBN has appeared the interesting information for PMCs. The fact is that now an ambitious project manager from %VICTIM_NAME% is working at %STATION_NAME%. Very soon the value of this place may skyrocket. Of course, this does not suit competitors at all. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is interested in throwing %VICTIM_NAME% somewhere outside the Inner System.

%STATION_NAME% can, for example, be bought. Any good deal requires strong negotiating positions. We will prepare such position for the customer. The elimination of an experienced manager will be a good step towards ensuring that the current owner of %STATION_NAME%, %VICTIM_NAME%, look at it as an unprofitable asset.
mission.Corp_Corp_Elimination2.objective: Search and destroy is business as usual. Your target: <color=#FFFEC1>manager</color>, usually not a combatant, but they are expected to fight back.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort1.after: As a reward for maintaining its market advantage, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a valuable <color=#FFFEC1>package</color>. Perhaps something invented by a rescued wiseguy. Well, or not. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort1.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. <color=#FFFEC1>Take the scientist</color> to the specified location on %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>PMCs</color>, so there should be no surprises. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Bring %BENEFICIARY_NAME% scientist to the safe location.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% have recently come close to a new scientific breakthrough. The research department at %STATION_NAME%, under the leadership of the energetic scientist, is truly blossoming. From the traffic analysis of the SBN it became clear that %VICTIM_NAME% is interested in the scientist at %STATION_NAME% stopping his work.

To complete this contract, we need to ensure his security, bringing him to the location specified by the specialists of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort1.objective0: Another day, another routine job. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the scientist to the safe location. Maybe he, if he survives, will invent something really important. Who knows!
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort2.after: As a reward for maintaining its market advantage, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a valuable <color=#FFFEC1>package</color>. Let's hope the manager whose life we ​​saved today was generous enough. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort2.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. <color=#FFFEC1>Take the manager</color> to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>PMCs</color>, so there should be no surprises. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the manager of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort2.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> An ambitious project manager for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% works at %STATION_NAME%. Very soon the value of this asset may jump sharply. Of course, this does not suit their competitors. According to the Security Service of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, %VICTIM_NAME% ordered the murder of the promising <color=#FFFEC1>manager</color>. We can take the contract for their <color=#FFFEC1>protection</color>. Not the most rewarding job, but a good way to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Escort2.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: escort the manager to the safe location specified by the Security Service of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is forced to change all operational plans. It <color=#FFFEC1>suspects</color> who the customer might be. If it decides to take revenge, we can accept <color=#FFFEC1>a contract</color> from it as well. The customer's representative %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took the PCPU and gave us the reward, it is already on the spacecraft.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage1.briefing: The sensors found one the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> that stuffed with data. However, the guards of %STATION_NAME% are already on their battle stations. We'll try to get you as close to the target as possible. <color=#FFFEC1>Take the device and come back</color>. Only distract yourself with something else if the risk is worth the reward.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the corporate <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage1.details:
Details: Recently, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations for %VICTIM_NAME%. A lot of market manipulation coming from here is directed against their competitor - %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. SBN is filled with mutual accusations and revelations. In this situation, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% would do well to know about the plans of %VICTIM_NAME%.

We should board %STATION_NAME%, find a corporate portable computer personal unit (the PCPU ) and take it with us. The interested party will definitely exchange it for something useful.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the corporate <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage2.after: We gave the representative of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% a prototype, and he gave us something that the corporation would like to test in the field. We exchange the worst for the bad, of course, but this is honest work.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage2.briefing: %STATION_NAME% has an unusual signature. 99.9% probability that this is %BENEFICIARY_NAME% <color=#FFFEC1>prototype</color> that the customer needs. We'll drop you off as close to your target as possible. Find a way through the security, <color=#FFFEC1>take the device and return</color>. If you decide to look for something unusual at %STATION_NAME%, make sure it's worth the risk.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up a <color=#FFFEC1>prototype</color> of a new invention at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage2.details:
Details: Analysts were able to calculate an interesting pattern in the information flow of %VICTIM_NAME%. It takes any attention away from %STATION_NAME%. This means there is work for us.

Corporations often publish open research in the SBN: minor summaries, analysis results, some scientific discoveries. This is called fulfilling one's duty to humanity.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% draws general attention to the fact that %STATION_NAME% is most likely developing something new. An obvious signal for PMCs to start acting.
mission.Corp_Corp_Espionage2.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the prototype of a new invention at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_Corp_Infiltration1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is forced to look for another way to learn about the plans of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. We have already received our reward, but it seems that events around this station are only gaining momentum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Infiltration1.briefing: Our opponents are colleagues from <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. Their HIS hovered nearby. Surely they know where the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> is located. Of course, we were not informed about this. It is necessary to <color=#FFFEC1>prevent infiltration</color> into %STATION_NAME% by destroying all infiltration groups. The contract does not include a clause on the inviolability of the customer's property, but do not be distracted from the task unless absolutely necessary.
mission.Corp_Corp_Infiltration1.details:
Details: Recently, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations for %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It learned that %VICTIM_NAME% was preparing an espionage operation on this station. The target will be the PCPU of a chief manager. If the device is stolen, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will have to redo all operational and strategic plans.

If we want to receive a reward for this contract, we must eliminate all infiltration teams, which will come for the PCPU.
mission.Corp_Corp_RaiderCapture1.after: Employees of %VICTIM_NAME% have already digitally signed the declaration of sale of the asset to %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. We elegantly handled the acquisition deal. The customer was satisfied, and the reward has already been transferred to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_RaiderCapture1.briefin: 10 seconds until landing. As soon as the <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service or PMC</color> guarding %STATION_NAME% realize that the battle is lost, they will retreat or lay down their arms. It is enough to <color=#FFFEC1>destroy 50% of the combatants</color>. If you think that you have enough strength and resources, you can explore this place. Apart from the capture, nothing else is included in the contract, that is, the customer will accept %STATION_NAME% in any condition. Welcome to the world of healthy and fair competition.
mission.Corp_Corp_RaiderCapture1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is actively increasing its influence in the Solar System. It uses the chaos of the new redistribution of property for sabotage, murder, espionage against competitors, the Unchained Belt and the Civil Resistance. %STATION_NAME% is the target of so-called "direct actions". This is where we come into the game.

A simple task: you will board on, then you should kill everyone who is able to hold a weapon, and then you should leave before this place becomes another branch of hell. Representatives of the customer will accept the object without us. %VICTIM_NAME% is already sending out protest notes through official channels and contracts for the protection of %STATION_NAME% through channels for PMCs.

Oh, I almost forgot. Clearing a station for capture offers a solid reward. And a trusting relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME% won't hurt at all.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage1.after: %STATION_NAME% has been removed from infrastructure of %VICTIM_NAME%. At least for some time. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is grateful to us that we correctly understood its hints in the SBN. It transferred valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage1.briefing: The location of the communication nodes is marked on your map. Don’t be surprised that it’s so far from you — we had to maneuver. The security of %STATION_NAME% has already been raised by alarm. Nothing unusual: local Security Service. Maybe a PMC. Let me remind you that the task is not to collect everything valuable in this place. The <color=#FFFEC1>task is to destroy the transmitters</color>.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has integrated %STATION_NAME% into its structure. Thanks to this asset, it managed to gain a strong foothold in the planetary market. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has been in a fierce bidding war for this asset recently. As long as %STATION_NAME% makes a profit, %VICTIM_NAME% will not want to get rid of it.

If you strike at communication system of %STATION_NAME%, this will complicate its work with the rest of %VICTIM_NAME% structural elements. Then the owner will think about selling it.

Analysis of information from the SBN shows: this is exactly what %BENEFICIARY_NAME% would like.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage1.objective0: We need to locate and destroy the transmitters. Each one is a <color=#FFFEC1>satellite dish</color> aimed at space. Their positions are marked on your map.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage2.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum as a reward. How many layers of irony are there?
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage2.briefing: We have <color=#FFFEC1>marked</color> the locations of the cargo on your map. The cargo is securely hidden deep within %STATION_NAME%. Such parcels are a common form of reward for <color=#FFFEC1>PMCs</color>, and corporations prefer not to advertise their collection and shipment. Our objective is to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the cargo</color>. You are permitted to deviate from the main task only if you discover something truly important.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the cargo of %VICTIM_NAME% prepared for shipment from %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage2.details:
Details: Our analysts monitor messages in the SBN in order to understand who needs our services. And something interesting is happening at %STATION_NAME%.

Recently, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% experienced an unpleasant incident at one of its assets. Our colleagues worked there. Apparently the customer was %VICTIM_NAME%. The work is done, it has already prepared cargo to be sent to the contractor.

If we destroy the package before it is transferred, we not only will we take revenge for %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, but we will also greatly ruin the lives of our competitors. So we are doing a good job: we support the anarcho-capitalist regime, we interfere with competitors, and most importantly, we work for remuneration.
mission.Corp_Corp_Sabotage2.objective0: You need to find and destroy the cargo prepared for sending to the PMC. This is a <color=#FFFEC1>mountain of boxes</color>. You yourself have seen these many times in the cargo hold of Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Control1.after: %STATION_NAME% continues to generate profits for %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is extremely grateful to us for our work. The valuable cargo has already been transferred to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Control1.briefing: The location of the communication center is marked on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them, <color=#FFFEC1>don't let them destroy the communication dish</color>.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Control1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has firmly integrated %STATION_NAME% into its structure. %VICTIM_NAME% has been operating around this station for some time. Apparently it needs %STATION_NAME% to establish a base of operations here.

Public enemies are planning an attack on the communication system of %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% is ready to attack at any moment.

Our task is to protect the equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Control1.objective0: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the transmitter</color>. It is a satellite dish aimed into space. There is a mark on your map.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Defense1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retained control of %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% did not have enough strength for a direct capture. This means that it will now move on to more traditional terrorist actions. There will be work for us here soon. In the meantime, Magnum received a cargo from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% as gratitude for the work.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Defense1.briefing:
It is necessary to take a defensive position and hold out until the attackers give up trying to storm the station. All the rabble belonging to %VICTIM_NAME% are heading here.

Collateral damage should not worry us. We have one mission: that %STATION_NAME% remains the property of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% when the dust settles and the smoke clears.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Defense1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is actively increasing its influence in the Solar System. Public enemies are using the chaos of the new redistribution of property for sabotage, murder, and espionage against system corporations.

%STATION_NAME% is subject to an attempt to seize it. If %VICTIM_NAME% succeeds, the asset will be removed from the market for a long time. The current owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, is already in full swing sending out calls to fight terrorism and contracts to ensure the security of the station. A good reason to earn extra money.

We'll land in the place specified by the customer and eliminate all the attackers until they stop trying to take the object by storm. Let's hold the station - the gratitude of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be very significant.
mission.Corp_Pirates_Elimination1.after: It was difficult for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% consultant to hide their joy. Perhaps in the future it will want to recapture %STATION_NAME% completely. Then there will be work for us again. The container with the reward is already on Magnum.
